!3 Text: the three row shapes
One line is one record. The expected file is a list of line patterns using !-${any}-!, !-${any-number}-! and !-${ignore}-!; the actual file has one more line, which the !-${ignore}-! line absorbs.

|script|text comparison|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/app.log|to file|src/test/resources/e2e/actual/app.log|OK|
|note|file to inline content, in {{{ }}} on several lines: the first line starts right after {{{, since a blank line counts in text|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/app.log|to|{{{08:00 INFO Application started
08:01 INFO Order A-7 created
08:02 WARN Slow query: 12 ms
08:03 INFO Application stopped
}}}|OK|
|note|inline to inline|
